within.en: It means that within a few years, the amount of power these buildings need could be more than double what it is today, on top of everything else the grid has to supply.
within.zh: 这意味着在短短几年内，这些建筑所需的电量可能会比现在翻上一倍多，而这还没算电网必须供应的其他一切用电。

widely.en: It made certain foods cheaper. Certain foods were now available more widely.
widely.zh: 它使某些食物更便宜。某些食物现在更广泛地供应。
